context_files_read.purpose: Read controlling repository safety and artifact integrity rules.
key_findings: Machine-readable artifacts are the product; charts, HTML, and markdown reports are views only.
Fake-only gates must never be presented as real Valkey evidence.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is not automatic and must not run without explicit opt-in.
Protected harness files must not be weakened, bypassed, deleted, or edited to hide changes.

context_files_read.purpose: Confirm automatic phase boundary and P14 opt-in requirements.
key_findings: Automatic work stops at P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100.
P14 may only run when VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN is explicitly set to I_UNDERSTAND_THIS_IS_NOT_A_DEFAULT_GATE.
Gate PASS results must be produced by scripts/codex_gate.py run, not manually written.

context_files_read.purpose: Read loop execution, stage context, and completion constraints.
key_findings: Each stage must re-read context and persist stage artifacts.
Completion requires previous harness, current harness, validation, anti-regression, stage_result PASS, commit, and push.
Real Valkey resource blockers must be recorded instead of converted into PASS.

context_files_read.purpose: Read the L02 goal and required harness scope.
key_findings: L02 must build an artifact provenance DAG.
Each analysis, report, and visualization result must trace to source artifact, sha256, producer, schema, phase, and run_id.
Reports must read artifacts but must never become source of truth.
P09 reports, P11 stability report, and P12/P13 scale reports are explicit acceptance targets.

context_files_read.purpose: Read stage-local constraints and already recorded risks.
key_findings: L02 must be static/artifact validation and must not run P14.
Historical gate, phase, and audit artifacts must not be edited to hide missing provenance.
Existing historical artifacts may lack producer or run_id; L02 must classify gaps instead of inventing metadata.
Broad graph building is risky unless tests prove missing source edges and SHA drift are blocking.

context_files_read.purpose: Use the L01 committed artifact audit as an inventory and boundary reference.
key_findings: Audit scope covers automatic phases P00 through P13 and optional P14.
P14 boundary is SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, dry_run_only true, real_valkey_coverage false, and real_evidence_count 0.
The report records artifact sha256 values for required artifacts, including P09, P11, P12, P13, and the P02 1000-node dry-run plan.
The report allowlists legacy gate manifest SHA drift across P00-P13 and records P13 scale_tests command mismatch as historical nonblocking.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect representative analysis artifact provenance fields.
key_findings: The artifact contains source_artifacts with path and sha256 entries from P08.
The source_artifacts entries do not themselves carry schema path, producer, phase_id, or run_id metadata.
Missing split-brain duration is encoded as MISSING with a reason and impact.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect representative report and visualization index.
key_findings: The report index hashes generated CSV, SVG, Markdown, and HTML outputs.
analysis_path is present but has no sha256, schema, phase, producer, or run_id edge metadata in this artifact.
The rendered outputs must be graph leaves or view nodes, not source-of-truth nodes.
The report points to stability_metrics.jsonl and stability_baseline_comparison.json by path only.
The report does not include source_artifacts, sha256 values, schema paths, or source node metadata for those inputs.
The soak profile is bounded and must not be upgraded into long-run stability evidence by a provenance graph.
The scale report embeds two scale_rung_summary objects.
Rungs include evidence_path values and the summary lists real_evidence_paths.
Neither rung nor report records source_artifacts or hashes for the evidence, resource preflight, cleanup, or state inputs.
The scale report status is PASS and includes rungs for 100 and 50 nodes.
The report lists real_evidence_paths for valkey_e2e_evidence_100.json and valkey_e2e_evidence_50.json.
The report does not include hashes or source metadata for those evidence paths.
Each rung has producer, phase_id, run_id, status, node_count, and evidence_path.
Each rung lacks source_artifacts and lacks evidence_path hash metadata.
Metrics are derived values and must remain traceable to live evidence and probe artifacts.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect existing 1000-node dry-run artifact that can be confused with real evidence.
key_findings: The plan has node_count 1000 and status PASS.
runtime.dry_run is true and every node is a dry-run node.
constraints.no_execution, constraints.opt_in_1000, and constraints.default_node_cap 100 are present.
This artifact is planner/dry-run provenance only and must never become real 1000-node Valkey evidence.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect current schema enforcement for provenance metadata.
key_findings: analysis_summary.schema.json requires core metadata, findings, and missing_metrics but does not require source_artifacts.
report_index.schema.json requires report output paths and sha256 values but does not require a hashed analysis input edge.
stability_report.schema.json and scale_ladder_report.schema.json require summaries but do not require source_artifacts.
Current schemas do not enforce L02's full source artifact, sha256, producer, schema, phase, and run_id contract.
create_analysis_summary reads P08 phase_summary, valkey_e2e_evidence, failover_report, and cleanup_report.
It records source_artifacts as path plus sha256 for JSON files in the source directory.
It does not enrich source_artifacts with schema path, producer, phase, or run_id.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect report rendering behavior and report-as-source risk.
key_findings: render_report reads analysis_summary.json and generates CSV, SVG, Markdown, and HTML report views.
report_index.json hashes generated views but records analysis_path without a sha256.
phase_summary.json records report outputs, which could be misused as evidence if the DAG lacks node types.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect stability and scale artifact producer behavior.
key_findings: write_stability_artifacts writes stability_report.json with metrics_timeseries_path and baseline_comparison_path only.
write_scale_ladder_artifacts writes scale_rung_N.json and scale_ladder_report.json with evidence_path and real_evidence_paths only.
The producers collect real runtime data, but current reports do not store hashed source edges.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect historical allowlist behavior that L02 must not inherit for source hash checks.
key_findings: LEGACY_GATE_MANIFEST_ALLOWLIST covers P00 through P13 for one historical manifest sha256.
Unallowlisted gate manifest mismatches are blocking current findings.
The allowlist is about historical gate manifest drift only and must not excuse missing or stale provenance source hashes.

findings.description: L02 can create fake provenance if it accepts path-only references as complete source edges.
evidence: artifacts/phases/P11_STABILITY_SOAK/stability_report.json has metrics_timeseries_path and baseline_comparison_path but no source sha256 values.
artifacts/phases/P12_SCALE_LADDER_10_30/scale_ladder_report.json lists real_evidence_paths but no hashes.
artifacts/phases/P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100/scale_ladder_report.json lists real_evidence_paths but no hashes.
codex/loop_engineering/04_STAGE_MANIFEST.md requires source artifact, sha256, producer, schema, phase, and run_id.

findings.description: Rendered reports and visualizations can be accidentally promoted to source-of-truth nodes because report_index.json hashes the view outputs.
evidence: artifacts/phases/P09_ANALYSIS_REPORTING/report_index.json records hashes for metrics.csv, missing_metrics.csv, baseline_comparison.csv, metric_chart.svg, report.md, and index.html.
src/valkey_scale_lab/report/render.py generates those outputs from analysis_summary.json.
AGENTS.md states charts, HTML, and markdown reports are only views over versioned artifacts.

findings.description: The existing 1000-node dry-run plan can be misread as real 1000-node evidence unless the DAG has explicit dry-run node typing and coverage classification.
evidence: artifacts/phases/P02_PLANNER/scale_1000_dryrun_plan.json has node_count 1000 and status PASS.
The same artifact has runtime.dry_run true, constraints.no_execution true, constraints.opt_in_1000 true, and default_node_cap 100.
artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/audit_report.json records P14 as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, dry_run_only true, real_valkey_coverage false, and real_evidence_count 0.
CODEX_START_HERE.md says P14 is not automatic and requires VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN.

findings.description: The L01 legacy gate-manifest allowlist could be copied too broadly into L02 and incorrectly excuse stale source artifact hashes.
evidence: scripts/audit_committed_artifacts.py defines LEGACY_GATE_MANIFEST_ALLOWLIST for P00 through P13.
artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/audit_report.json records allowlist=legacy_gate_manifest_sha256 for many P00-P13 gate manifest mismatches.
L02 source hash checks need exact path and sha256 freshness; historical gate manifest drift is a different class of finding.

findings.description: Existing analysis and report schemas do not require the provenance metadata L02 is supposed to guarantee.
evidence: schemas/artifact/analysis_summary.schema.json does not require source_artifacts.
schemas/artifact/report_index.schema.json does not require an analysis input sha256 or source metadata.
schemas/artifact/stability_report.schema.json does not require source_artifacts.
schemas/artifact/scale_ladder_report.schema.json does not require source_artifacts.

findings.description: A graph that only records hashes already present in reports cannot detect when an upstream source artifact changed after the report was rendered.
evidence: artifacts/phases/P09_ANALYSIS_REPORTING/report_index.json records analysis_path without sha256.
src/valkey_scale_lab/report/render.py writes report_index.json using _report_record only for generated outputs.
P11 and P12/P13 reports store source paths without hashes, so a stale view can still look internally hash-consistent.

findings.description: Scale and stability derived metrics can look authoritative while lacking direct graph edges to the evidence, metrics JSONL, cleanup, and resource-preflight artifacts that produced them.
evidence: artifacts/phases/P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100/scale_rung_50.json and scale_rung_100.json contain derived memory and command metrics plus evidence_path but no source_artifacts.
artifacts/phases/P11_STABILITY_SOAK/stability_report.json embeds workload, latency, leak, restart, and baseline summaries but only path-links to metrics and baseline artifacts.
artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/audit_report.json has sha256 inventory for required artifacts, but L02 must produce an explicit DAG rather than relying on inventory adjacency.

findings.description: L02 can weaken the existing harness if it edits historical artifacts, broadens schemas, or downgrades existing gate/audit requirements to make provenance pass.
evidence: AGENTS.md identifies scripts, schemas, codex manifests, docs, templates, workflows, and gate controls as protected harness files.
artifacts/loop_engineering/stages/L02_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_DAG/read_context.md says historical gate, phase, and audit artifacts must not be edited to hide missing provenance.
The user explicitly requested no source/test or historical artifact edits and no P14 or real/fault wrapper gate execution.

proposed_harness.name: provenance_graph_schema_strict_nodes_edges
proposed_harness.acceptance: schemas/artifact/provenance_graph.schema.json requires nodes with path, sha256, artifact_type, phase_id, run_id, producer, schema_path, status, and source_class, plus edges with relationship, from, to, and missing_metadata semantics.

proposed_harness.name: static_provenance_graph_builder
proposed_harness.acceptance: A static builder emits artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json for P09, P11, P12, and P13 without running P14, valkey_e2e_gate.py, fault_safety_gate.py, or fault_failover_gate.py.

proposed_harness.name: p09_report_views_are_leaf_nodes
proposed_harness.acceptance: Tests prove P09 CSV, SVG, HTML, and Markdown are view nodes derived from analysis_summary.json and cannot satisfy source evidence requirements for metrics.

proposed_harness.name: p11_stability_path_hash_edges
proposed_harness.acceptance: Tests fail when stability_report.json path references to stability_metrics.jsonl or stability_baseline_comparison.json cannot be resolved to nodes with current sha256, schema, phase, producer, and run_id metadata.

proposed_harness.name: p12_p13_scale_real_evidence_edges
proposed_harness.acceptance: Tests require each scale rung and scale_ladder_report real_evidence_path to resolve to a real Valkey evidence node with current sha256, schema, phase, run_id, producer, real_valkey true, and node-count classification.

proposed_harness.name: p14_1000_dryrun_graph_boundary
proposed_harness.acceptance: The graph classifies P02 1000-node plan and any P14 artifacts as dry_run/planner/resource only, records P14 as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON when absent, and never counts either as real 1000-node evidence.

proposed_harness.name: source_hash_drift_is_blocking
proposed_harness.acceptance: Fixture tests mutate a source artifact after a report is generated and require the provenance checker to report a blocking source_hash_mismatch.

proposed_harness.name: allowlist_scope_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: CI tests ensure the legacy gate manifest allowlist does not apply to provenance source hashes, missing source nodes, missing metadata, or P14 real-evidence classification.

proposed_harness.name: no_historical_artifact_mutation_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: Anti-regression checks fail if L02 modifies artifacts/gates, artifacts/phases historical outputs, audit decisions, or existing reports to manufacture provenance instead of recording findings.

implementation_plan.step: Define a provenance DAG schema before implementing graph generation.
implementation_plan.rationale: The L02 acceptance contract is schema-level metadata completeness, not only best-effort report parsing.

implementation_plan.step: Build a read-only static graph generator that walks selected machine-readable artifacts and computes current hashes.
implementation_plan.rationale: Computing hashes from files prevents stale embedded hashes or report-only hashes from becoming trusted provenance.

implementation_plan.step: Classify node types and edge relationships explicitly.
implementation_plan.rationale: Reports, visualizations, analysis artifacts, real evidence, cleanup, resource preflight, dry-run plans, JSONL metrics, and missing/skipped references need different trust levels.

implementation_plan.step: Add tests for P09, P11, P12, P13, and P14 dry-run boundary behavior using current artifacts plus fixtures.
implementation_plan.rationale: Representative artifact coverage is required to catch path-only provenance, report-as-source behavior, source hash drift, and dry-run confusion.

implementation_plan.step: Wire validation without weakening L00/L01 harnesses or historical artifact checks.
implementation_plan.rationale: L02 must extend the audit chain while preserving previous harness behavior and protected artifact discipline.

acceptance_criteria: artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json exists and validates against a strict DAG schema.
Every P09 report output traces to analysis_summary.json and then to P08 machine-readable source artifacts with current sha256, producer, schema, phase, and run_id metadata.
P09 HTML, Markdown, CSV, and SVG outputs are typed as views and cannot be counted as source-of-truth evidence.

P11 stability_report.json traces to stability_metrics.jsonl, stability_baseline_comparison.json, valkey_e2e_evidence.json, and cleanup artifacts, or records explicit MISSING/SKIPPED_WITH_REASON findings.
P12 and P13 scale_ladder_report.json and scale_rung artifacts trace to real Valkey evidence, resource preflight, cleanup, and state artifacts with current hashes and node-count classifications.
P02 scale_1000_dryrun_plan.json and any P14 artifact are typed as dry_run/planner/resource only and never counted as real Valkey coverage.
Any missing source node, missing required metadata, source hash drift, or cycle in the graph is a finding with blocking severity unless it has a narrow, typed SKIPPED_WITH_REASON edge.
The legacy gate manifest allowlist remains limited to L01 gate manifest drift and does not apply to L02 source artifact hashes.
No historical artifact, gate result, audit decision, source file, or test file is edited by this risk_auditor task.
risks: Block completion if any P09, P11, P12, or P13 analysis/report/visualization artifact lacks a path to machine-readable source nodes with current sha256.
Block completion if HTML, Markdown, SVG, or CSV report outputs can satisfy a source evidence edge.
Block completion if P02 1000-node dry-run or absent P14 artifacts are represented as real 1000-node Valkey evidence.
Block completion if a broad allowlist suppresses source hash drift, missing source nodes, missing metadata, or P14 boundary violations.
Block completion if graph nodes omit producer, schema_path, phase_id, run_id, status, or artifact_type without an explicit MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON record.
Block completion if the graph accepts cycles or lets a report depend on itself through report_index or phase_summary references.
Block completion if L02 changes historical artifacts to add provenance retroactively instead of reporting missing provenance findings.
Block completion if L02 weakens existing schemas, audit report semantics, phase manifest rules, gate locks, postcheck compatibility, or loop-engineering validation to make the graph pass.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, or scripts/fault_failover_gate.py for this risk audit.
Do not edit artifacts/gates, artifacts/phases historical outputs, audit decisions, reports, source files, tests, schemas, codex manifests, or workflows in this subagent task.
Do not invent producer, schema, phase, run_id, or status metadata for historical artifacts that lack it.
Do not treat report_index.json, report.md, index.html, metric_chart.svg, or CSV files as source-of-truth artifacts.
Do not count any dry-run planner/resource artifact as real Valkey coverage.
Do not reuse the legacy gate manifest allowlist for provenance hash freshness checks.
Do not relax existing schema required fields, gate checks, test assertions, or CI coverage to make provenance validation pass.
commands_to_run: git diff -- tests scripts schemas .github codex artifacts/gates artifacts/phases artifacts/loop_engineering
notes: Approved for L02 harness design under the blocker conditions above. This risk audit is static and did not run P14 or any real/fault wrapper gate. The main risk is not that current artifacts are useless; many have good core metadata and hashes in the L01 inventory. The risk is that L02 must compute and enforce an explicit DAG rather than trusting path-only references, rendered report hashes, broad historical allowlists, or dry-run PASS artifacts as real provenance.
